name: RagBucket
description: A company product: a managed collection of ingested documents (from object storage, SharePoint, etc.) stored across internal tables and made queryable + semantically searchable.
use_cases: The user refers to 'the RagBucket', 'ingested documents', or a document collection.
You need the raw text or metadata of documents that were ingested into a bucket.
Example: 'How many documents are in the support RagBucket?'
returns: Rows from the RagBucket's backing tables (documents, text, metadata).
cost: cheap to query; ingestion cost scales with document count

grounding.query_hint: Join ragbucket_documents d to ragbucket_document_text t ON t.document_id = d.id; extracted text is t.content.
